description:
Music for Nervous System Regulation | Santoor Instrumental | 1.5 Hours

Your body is safe. Let it find that out slowly - one soft note at a time.

This gentle santoor music is made for nervous system regulation: easing a body stuck on alert, settling a racing heart, and bringing you back to a calm, steady baseline. Nothing to do. Nothing to fix.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of warm Indian santoor in Raga Bhupali over a steady tanpura drone, with no drums, no vocals and no ads interrupting.

▶ Keep settling - the full Meditation playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199nvhUBCx5L9ROrDP44H4JzN
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing - it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for somatic practice, vagus nerve exercises, breathwork, grounding after a stressful night, morning meditation, journaling, gentle yoga, therapy homework, or simply sitting still until your shoulders drop.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Santoor (Indian hammered dulcimer) with tanpura drone
Raga: Bhupali (a light, open, pentatonic raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Warm, settled, unhurried
Atmosphere: An open window at first light, a hand on the chest
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play it low. Put one hand on your chest, one on your belly, and let the out-breath get a little longer than the in-breath. Stay until the body believes it.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Body on alert
9:00 First long exhale
18:00 Shoulders dropping
27:00 Heart slowing
36:00 Hands warming
45:00 Safe enough
54:00 Settled
1:03:00 Steady baseline
1:12:00 Soft and present
1:21:00 Carry it with you

⏱ BEST FOR
• Nervous system regulation
• Anxiety and panic recovery
• Somatic and vagus nerve practice
• Breathwork
• Morning meditation
• Journaling
• Gentle yoga

If this music helped you, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian instrumental music.
